notes: Verified the new tests fail on main's implementation: swapping in main's security.go makes TestRBACDiffExpansions_DroppingResourceNamesIsAnExpansion, _WildcardAlreadyCoversNarrowerRule, _NonResourceURLs and TestIsRiskyPermission_APIGroupWildcard fail; the handler test does not compile without ClusterID. With HEAD, go build/vet and the analyzer+proxy RBAC tests pass.

rbacCovers matches the API server's semantics (ResourceAll, exact match, */subresource suffix, non-resource '*' and trailing-'*' prefix, verb/group wildcards, resourceNames as per-object limit). Spot-checked over-reach cases ('*/scale' vs 'deployments', group wildcard on another resource) are covered by TestRBACDiffExpansions_WildcardDoesNotOverReach.

internal/analyzer/security.go:496 comment says a non-resource URL 'always starts with /' so it cannot collide with a core resource, but nonResourceURLs:["*"] renders as '|*|*', the same key as apiGroups:[""] resources:["*"] verbs:["*"]. If one revision adds both, the seen-dedupe collapses them into a single entry. Both are flagged risky so nothing is hidden from the risky count semantics, only one row label is lost — cosmetic, not a merge blocker.

Commit 98732a9 (Kinds filter on the inventory fetch) has no dedicated test for the window-narrowing behaviour; the handler test exercises the Kinds path only incidentally (only Role rows are seeded). store.K8sInventoryFilter.Kinds already exists and is implemented with lower(kind) IN (...), so the change is a one-line filter addition with low risk.
Scope is tight: all five files touched relate to SEC-08 RBAC Diff; the admin_ui.go change is a header label only. No auth, migration, or external-state changes; fully revertable.
